title: RCER: Reconstructing Cross-Evidence Relations for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Iterative retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) accumulates knowledge from retrieved evidence to answer complex questions, but existing methods struggle to reconstruct entity correspondences and inferential dependencies across retrieved passages as new information emerges. We propose RCER, an iterative RAG method that reconstructs these cross-evidence relations directly from accumulated source passages. Inter-round relational evidence acquisition identifies entity correspondences and relational dependencies to drive dynamic problem decomposition and iterative retrieval. Reasoning context reconstruction independently constructs a coherent reasoning context through joint selection of complementary passages and derivation of cross-evidence inferences. translated_title: RCER：面向迭代检索增强生成的跨证据关系重构
translated_abstract: 迭代检索增强生成（RAG）通过从检索到的证据中积累知识来回答复杂问题，但随着新信息的出现，现有方法难以在检索到的段落之间重构实体对应关系和推理依赖关系。我们提出了RCER，这是一种迭代RAG方法，能够直接从积累的源段落中重构这些跨证据关系。轮间关系证据获取识别实体对应关系和关系依赖，以驱动动态问题分解和迭代检索。推理上下文重构通过联合选择互补段落并推导跨证据推断，独立构建连贯的推理上下文。跨证据组合推理利用这些推断建立实体对应关系，并在所选段落之间组合关系以推导答案。实验表明
tldr: 提出RCER迭代检索增强生成方法，通过轮间关系证据获取、推理上下文重构和跨证据组合推理，直接从积累的源段落中重构实体对应关系与推理依赖关系，从而更好地回答复杂问题。
en_tdlr: RCER is an iterative RAG method that reconstructs cross-evidence relations—entity correspondences and inferential dependencies—directly from accumulated source passages via inter-round relational evidence acquisition, reasoning context reconstruction, and cross-evidence compositional reasoning to better answer complex questions.
